author: Steam (Valve) YouTube
text:
The Steam Awards 2026 - 10th Anniversary
The Steam Awards is celebrating TEN YEARS of celebrating games! Yes, we said celebrating twice! You can nominate your favorite games of the year across 14 categories from November 23rd through 30th.

https://store.steampowered.com/steamawards/nominations

Yes, we said FOURTEEN categories, including a Hall of Fame for all of the previous Game of the Year winners. Check out the video for more on a couple new, specifically-because-we’re-celebrating-the-tenth-anniversary categories this year.
